name: polygon-rush
description: Polygon Rush - an endless shape-shifting runner. Rush, jump, flip and fly through infinite polygon worlds solo, against rivals, or with friends.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
